# Monaco JSON preview support

These unmodified files come from the official `monaco-editor@0.52.2` npm package,
matching the existing bundled editor version. They are required when the Files
viewer opens JSON artifacts such as AUTO research's `delivery.json`.

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/monaco-editor/-/monaco-editor-0.52.2.tgz
- Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor
- Source directory: `package/min/vs/language/json/`
- License: MIT; the package license is retained in `LICENSE`.

Do not edit the minified files manually. Update them together with the bundled
editor when upgrading Monaco.
